entities.name: Otto Pächt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otto Pächt was an Austrian art historian and one of the representatives of the second wave of the Vienna School of Art History. He mostly wrote on the medieval and Renaissance art of Europe. An exile from the Nazis, he taught in England and United States, before returning to Austria in 1963.

entities.summary: Otto Pächt was an Austrian art historian and one of the representatives of the second wave of the Vienna School of Art History.
